Limitations: no longer-period or global-basin claims.

value.rationale: The shortest nontrivial cycles are a natural quantitative invariant of Everett’s geometric discontinuous dynamical system. A complete parameter-space 0/1/2 classification and sharp isosceles bifurcation heights fill the concrete gap between numerical pictures, prescribed projection contractions and actual farthest-choice admissibility. It handles all nondegenerate triangles and both distinct cycle orientations, not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine parameter increment.
